response.justification: While Bogdan brings 17+ years of software engineering and proven expertise in distributed systems (Dunnhumby's millions-request-per-second infrastructure), he lacks critical CTO requirements: no demonstrated experience scaling engineering teams or building technical leadership (required 5+ years), minimal production multi-agent AI systems work (<1 year, contribution-level at re:cinq), and no fintech infrastructure domain knowledge. He is overqualified for senior IC roles but significantly underprepared for executive technical leadership of an AI-native fintech organization.
strengths: 17+ years of software engineering across diverse domains with proven expertise in high-scale, real-time distributed systems (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second with low-latency data processing)
Deep technical foundation in microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and complex infrastructure scaling across multiple technology stacks
Current exposure to agentic AI workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq demonstrates ability to learn emerging technologies quickly
concerns: No evidence of engineering leadership experience or scaling teams from 10 to 30+ people—a hard requirement for CTO role unfulfilled

Minimal production multi-agent AI systems experience; recent AI work at re:cinq is contribution-level and less than one year old, with no mention of architectural design, observability, or evaluation infrastructure
Complete absence of fintech infrastructure domain knowledge (credit systems, payment flows, working-capital management) despite this being central to the role and company's business
